title: Palm Sugar Lime Shrimp Skewers
seoTitle: Palm Sugar Lime Shrimp Skewers | Firehall BBQ
shortDescription: Shrimp skewer night—honey sriracha glaze, fast char, no generic kabob repeat
subtitle: Kaffir lime glazed jumbo shrimp, Thai basil, and char for ten
description: Jumbo shrimp marinate briefly in lime and garlic, grill on skewers until pink and 140°F, and glaze with honey-sriracha in the final minute.

steps.title: Marinate shrimp briefly
steps.instruction: Toss shrimp with half the lime juice, garlic, fish sauce, and salt. Marinate 20–30 minutes refrigerated only.

steps.title: Build honey sriracha glaze
steps.instruction: Whisk honey, sriracha, and remaining lime juice until smooth. Reserve for basting.

steps.title: Heat grill hot
steps.instruction: Preheat grill to high, 450°F. Oil grates. Have glaze and brush ready.

steps.title: Skewer shrimp
steps.instruction: Thread 4–5 shrimp per skewer in a flat line for even contact. Pat dry before grilling.

steps.title: Grill shrimp
steps.instruction: Grill skewers 2 minutes per side until pink, lightly charred, and 135–140°F internal.

steps.title: Glaze finish
steps.instruction: Brush honey sriracha and grill 30 seconds per side until sticky. Move to cooler zone if sugar burns.

steps.title: Hold at 140°F
steps.instruction: Rest skewers 2 minutes. Transfer to hotel pans, cover loosely, hold at 140°F up to 12 minutes max.

steps.title: Serve with herbs
steps.instruction: Scatter cilantro and green onions at the line. About 8 oz shrimp per firefighter.

proTips: Never marinate shrimp over 30 minutes—lime turns them mushy.
Flat skewer layout beats stacked shrimp for even char.
140°F hold max—shrimp tighten up fast above that.
tonightSpread: Honey sriracha shrimp skewers with lime and cilantro.
Coconut rice or quick noodle salad on the side.
leftovers: Pull shrimp for Thai-style lettuce wraps.
Chop into fried rice with extra sriracha.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Shrimp skewers cook in under 10 minutes—ideal when the tone might drop. They hold covered at 140°F briefly and taste best with fresh lime at service.
mealPrepNotes: Marinate shrimp 20–30 minutes max—acid toughens longer soaks. Grill high 450°F, 2 minutes per side. Hold covered at 140°F up to 12 minutes. Glaze at service if needed.
